{{2024–25 Atlantic 10 men's basketball standings}}
The '''2024–25 VCU Rams men's basketball team''' represented [[Virginia Commonwealth University]] during the [[2024–25 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Rams, led by second-year head coach [[Ryan Odom]], played their home games at the [[Siegel Center]] in [[Richmond, Virginia]], as a member of the [[Atlantic 10 Conference]]. They finished the season 28–7, 15–3 in [[2024–25 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|A-10 play]] to win the regular season championship. They defeated [[2024–25 St. Bonaventure Bonnies men's basketball team|St. Bonaventure]], [[2024–25 Loyola Ramblers men's basketball team|Loyola Chicago]], and [[2024–25 George Mason Patriots men's basketball team|George Mason]] to win the [[2025 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 tournament]] championship. As a result, they received the conference's automatic bid to the [[2025 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 11 seed in the East region. They lost to [[2024–25 BYU Cougars men's basketball team|BYU]] in the first round.

On March 22, 2025, head coach Ryan Odom left the team to take the head coaching position at [[Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball|Virginia]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-03-22 |title=Virginia hires VCU's Ryan Odom, who coached UMBC over Cavs in historic 16-vs.-1 NCAA tournament upset |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/college-basketball/article/virginia-hires-vcus-ryan-odom-who-coached-umbc-over-cavs-in-historic-16-vs-1-ncaa-tournament-upset-214614488.html |access-date=2025-04-01 |website=Yahoo Sports |language=en-US}}</ref> On March 25, the school named [[Bryant Bulldogs men's basketball|Bryant]] head coach [[Phil Martelli Jr.]] the team's new head coach.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-03-26 |title=VCU hires Bryant's Martelli Jr. to replace Odom |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/44409880/vcu-targeting-bryant-phil-martelli-jr-next-head-coach-sources-say |access-date=2025-04-01 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}}</ref>

== Previous season ==
{{main|2023–24 VCU Rams men's basketball team}}
The 2023–24 team was the first year with Ryan Odom coaching the squad. During the season, VCU finished the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|season]] with a 24–14 record including an 11–7 record in Atlantic 10 play. The Rams lost in the Atlantic 10 championship game to [[2023–24 Duquesne Dukes men's basketball team|Duquesne]], and earned an at-large berth into the [[2024 National Invitation Tournament]]. In the NIT, the Rams had their best performance in the tournament since 1988, reaching the quarterfinals before losing to [[2023–24 Utah Utes men's basketball team|Utah]].{{citation needed|date= March 2024}}
